newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's Kirishi oil refinery boosts 1996 output.
newsitem.headline: Russia's Kirishi oil refinery boosts 1996 output.

text.p: Russia's OAO Kirishinefteorgsintez refinery processed 15.30 million tonnes of crude oil in 1996, 26 percent more than the 12.13 million tonnes it ran in 1995, the refinery said in statement on Thursday.
It produced 4.95 million tonnes of heavy fuel oil last year against 3.58 million tonnes in 1995. Bunker fuel production was 830,200 tonnes, but no comparison for 1995 was available.
Production of gasoline and jet fuel also rose in 1996 over 1995 levels.
Kirishinefteorgsintez, also known as Kirishi, is owned by NK Surgut Holding, one of Russia's top oil companies, and is strategically located outside St Petersburg in northwestern Russia.
The refinery is Russia's top supplier of heavy fuel oil to European markets. Its total capacity is about 20 million tonnes a year (400,000 barrels per day).
